title: Packaged candidate ships a third-party license notice that asserts PySide6/Shiboken6/Qt components which are not present in the bundle
observed: dist/hpc-client-gui/_internal/QT_LGPL_SOURCE_OFFER.md states "HPC Client GUI binary releases contain PySide6, Shiboken6, and Qt components distributed under applicable LGPLv3 terms" and refers to a THIRD_PARTY_VERSIONS.txt manifest for exact versions.

measured_bundle_contents.wx_v2_runtime: wxbase333u / wxmsw333u_core / wxmsw333u_webview / wxmsw333u_html vc140_x64 (wxWidgets 3.3.3) + WebView2Loader.dll

why_this_is_a_defect: The notice is a licensing representation about artifact contents and it is false for this bundle. The declared runtime is wxWidgets V2 WebView, not Qt/PySide6, so the corresponding-source obligation it claims does not apply and the referenced THIRD_PARTY_VERSIONS.txt is not present in the bundle. Shipping a false third-party attribution is a release-integrity defect independent of any single test outcome.

owner_routing.routed_not_fixed_because: W57 Frozen-candidate invariants forbid patching the frozen candidate: any package-content correction invalidates W56 and must be routed to the owner, rebuilt, then affected W56/W57 evidence rerun. W57 must not opportunistically edit package content it does not own.
owner_routing.invalidates: W56 candidate identity; requires rebuild and W56/W57 packaged regression rerun

related: Interacts with the T03 candidate-identity instability (on-disk exe 8ba80453... vs recorded frozen caa5904a...). Both must be resolved by the packaging owner before W57 can emit a freeze declaration.
not_done: no package file was edited or deleted
